_comment: Generic guide catalog only. Bootstrap pulls the live checklist from each project's CNCF onboarding issue and matches items here for guides/slugs/flags.

categories.heading: Required before CNCF staff can proceed
categories.intro: A signed Project Contribution Agreement and trademark transfer are required **before** CNCF staff can complete the rest of onboarding. Other items can be worked on in parallel.

items.title: Review and understand the CNCF IP Policy
items.guide: Review the [CNCF IP Policy](https://github.com/cncf/foundation/blob/main/charter.md#11-ip-policy). Ensure the project uses a CNCF-compatible license — inbound projects must use **Apache 2.0**. (Dependency licenses are tracked separately in `license-scan-import`.)
items.evidence_hint: _Confirm license is Apache 2.0 and link to the LICENSE file._

items.title: Review and understand the CNCF Third Party License Policy
items.guide: Review the [CNCF Allowlist License Policy](https://github.com/cncf/foundation/blob/main/policies-guidance/allowed-third-party-license-policy.md). This governs licenses used by third-party dependencies. CNCF FOSSA or CNCF Snyk can check compliance — pick one (tracked in `license-scan-import`).
items.evidence_hint: _Note which scanning service you'll use (FOSSA or Snyk)._

items.title: Review and understand the LF trademark guidelines
match_phrases: plan to change your project name
items.guide: Review the [Linux Foundation trademark guidelines](https://www.linuxfoundation.org/trademark-usage/). Let the TOC know if you plan to change your project name.
items.evidence_hint: _Confirm review complete; note any planned name change (or N/A)._

items.title: Transfer trademark and logo assets to the Linux Foundation
items.guide: Transfer any existing trademark and logo assets to the Linux Foundation via the Project Contribution Agreement. CNCF staff sends this document to the contact emails listed in your Sandbox application.
items.evidence_hint: _Date Contribution Agreement was signed, or status if pending._

items.title: Review the Technical Leadership Principles
items.guide: Read the [Technical Leadership Principles](https://contribute.cncf.io/maintainers/community/leadership-principles/), which outline expected behavior for maintainers in leadership roles.

items.title: Review the project proposal process and requirements
items.guide: Read the [CNCF project proposal process and requirements](https://github.com/cncf/toc/blob/main/process/README.md).

items.title: Review services available for your project at the CNCF
items.guide: Read about [services available to CNCF projects](https://contribute.cncf.io/resources/project-services/).

items.title: Review the online program guidelines
items.guide: Read the CNCF online program guidelines (webinars, meetups, events) provided by CNCF staff.

items.title: Review the telemetry data collection and usage policy
match_phrases: telemetry data collection and usage policy
items.guide: Read the CNCF telemetry data collection and usage policy.

items.title: Optional: book time with CNCF staff
items.guide: Optional: book time with CNCF staff to walk through available resources, work through onboarding tasks together, or ask questions.
items.evidence_hint: _Meeting date, or N/A if not needed._

items.title: Move the project to its own separate neutral GitHub organization
items.guide: This makes the project transferable to the CNCF's GitHub Enterprise account. If it's already in another GitHub Enterprise account, remove it from there first.

items.title: Accept the invite to join the CNCF GitHub Enterprise account
match_phrases: Accept the invite to join the CNCF GitHub Enterprise
items.guide: CNCF will add `thelinuxfoundation` as an organization owner to ensure neutral hosting.

items.title: Migrate Slack channels to the Kubernetes or CNCF Slack workspace
items.guide: CNCF staff can help. This improves discoverability, lets CNCF enforce its Code of Conduct, and enables unlimited message retention. If you already have a large Slack/Discord community, CNCF may instead link to it from a pointer channel in the CNCF Slack workspace.
items.evidence_hint: _Migration status or link to pointer channel._

items.title: Join the #maintainers-circle Slack channel
items.guide: Join `#maintainers-circle` on CNCF Slack to find and share knowledge with other project teams.

items.title: Transfer project domain(s) to the CNCF
items.guide: If your project has its own domain(s), transfer them to the CNCF. LF Contact: `projects@cncf.io`. Project Selection: CNCF.

items.title: Submit a pull request with your artwork
items.guide: Submit project artwork to [cncf/artwork](https://github.com/cncf/artwork). If you don't have artwork, CNCF can help design some.

items.title: Transfer website analytics to the CNCF
items.guide: If you use Google Analytics, add `projects@cncf.io` as an admin of your existing account so it can be moved to a CNCF-managed account. If you don't have GA, note your current analytics setup instead.

items.title: Create or update the .project repo with maintainer information
match_phrases: up to date with maintainer information
items.guide: Create or ensure your [`.project` repo](https://contribute.cncf.io/blog/2026/04/22/introducing-dot-project-for-maintainers) is up to date with maintainer information.

items.title: Create a maintainer list and add it to the aggregated CNCF maintainer list
items.guide: Create/verify `MAINTAINERS.md` and open a PR against the aggregated CNCF maintainer list (or keep the `.project` repo current if that is the path your onboarding issue specifies).
items.evidence_hint: _Link to MAINTAINERS.md / .project repo and any related PR._

items.title: Ensure each maintainer has an up-to-date LFX Individual Dashboard profile
items.guide: Ensure each maintainer has an up-to-date [LFX Individual Dashboard profile](https://openprofile.dev/) with an active email address for mailing list and Service Desk access.

items.title: Provide maintainer emails for mailing list and Service Desk access
items.guide: Email maintainer addresses to `project-onboarding@cncf.io` (not shared publicly), or ensure LFX profiles include active emails if that is what your onboarding issue requires. Also link each maintainer's GitHub ID with their LF profile.

items.title: Ensure the DCO app is enabled for all project GitHub repositories
items.guide: Enable the [DCO GitHub App](https://github.com/apps/dco) on every repo in scope. A CLA may be used in addition to the DCO, not instead of it.

items.title: Reference the CNCF Code of Conduct in README.md
items.guide: Explicitly reference the CNCF Code of Conduct (or your adopted version) in the project's `README.md` on GitHub.

items.title: Add the LF footer to your website (or README if no website)
items.guide: Add the Linux Foundation footer to your website per [LF branding guidelines](https://github.com/cncf/foundation/blob/main/policies-guidance/website-guidelines.md). If you don't have a dedicated website, adopt these guidelines for `README.md` instead.
items.evidence_hint: _Link to footer on the site or README section._

items.title: Start a GOVERNANCE.md documenting open governance
items.guide: Document written, open governance in a `GOVERNANCE.md` file at the root of your repo.

items.title: Start a SECURITY.md security policy
items.guide: Document a security policy in a `SECURITY.md` file at the root of your repo. See [CNCF security guidelines](https://contribute.cncf.io/maintainers/security/security-guidelines/#3-securitymd).

items.title: Start an OpenSSF Best Practices Badge
items.guide: Register and begin working toward an [OpenSSF Best Practices Badge](https://www.bestpractices.dev/).

items.title: Import all project repos into a license scanning service
items.guide: Import all repos in scope into CNCF FOSSA or CNCF Snyk (see `license-policy-review`).
items.evidence_hint: _Service used and confirmation all repos are imported._

categories.heading: CNCF staff tasks (track and follow up)
categories.intro: These are completed by CNCF staff, not the project. Track them here so you know what to follow up on; check the box once staff confirms completion.

items.title: CNCF staff: add the project to DevStats
items.guide: CNCF staff adds the project to [DevStats](https://all.devstats.cncf.io/).
items.evidence_hint: _Link to the project's DevStats dashboard once available._

items.title: CNCF staff: add the project to CLOMonitor
items.guide: CNCF staff adds the project to [CLOMonitor](https://clomonitor.io/).
items.evidence_hint: _Link to the project's CLOMonitor report card._

items.title: CNCF staff: add the project to LFX Insights
match_phrases: Add the project to LFX Insights
items.guide: CNCF staff adds the project to [LFX Insights](https://insights.linuxfoundation.org/).
items.evidence_hint: _Link to LFX Insights for the project._

items.title: CNCF staff: activate the project in the LFX Project Control Center
match_phrases: Activate the project in the LFX Project Control Center
items.guide: CNCF staff activates the project in the LFX Project Control Center (PCC).

items.title: CNCF staff: add the project to the Cloud Native Landscape
items.guide: After PCC activation, CNCF staff adds the project to the [Cloud Native Landscape](https://landscape.cncf.io/), including the `lfx_slug` in the landscape configuration file.

items.title: CNCF staff: add the maintainers team to the license scanner
match_phrases: maintainers team to a license scanner
maintainers team to the license scanner
items.guide: CNCF staff adds the maintainers team to the chosen license scanner service (FOSSA or Snyk).

items.title: CNCF staff: create a groups.io project maintainer list in PCC
match_phrases: groups.io project maintainer list in PCC
items.guide: CNCF staff creates a groups.io maintainer list for the project in the LFX Project Control Center.

items.title: CNCF staff: create project in CNCF Service Desk
match_phrases: Create project in CNCF Service desk
items.guide: CNCF staff creates the project in the CNCF Service Desk.

items.title: CNCF staff: run Onboard Project workflow
items.guide: CNCF staff runs the [Onboard Project workflow](https://github.com/cncf/maintainer-manager/actions/workflows/onboard-project.yml).
items.evidence_hint: _Link to the workflow run, or confirmation complete._

items.title: CNCF staff: add the project's groups.io list to maintainers@cncf.io
items.guide: CNCF staff adds the project's groups.io maintainer list to `maintainers@cncf.io`.

items.title: CNCF staff: send a welcome email confirming maintainer list access
items.guide: CNCF staff sends a welcome email confirming maintainer mailing list and Service Desk access.

items.title: Final review: confirm all items complete and request sign-off
items.guide: When every item above is complete (or intentionally N/A), post a status update on your CNCF onboarding issue and ask CNCF staff to confirm and close it. Run `./scripts/generate-status-report.sh` to produce a paste-ready update, or `./scripts/generate-status-report.sh --post` to post it directly as a comment.
items.evidence_hint: _Link to the comment confirming onboarding complete, and the closed onboarding issue._
